scenario: Datawise is in the deal and the buyer raised a security/compliance objection. What should I do?

rules.criterion: Recommends conducting an early security-first review (SOC 2, RBI data residency, dedicated single-tenant VPC isolation)
Cites an empirical win/loss ratio consistent with seed data (e.g. 4 of 5 won with security-first review; 3 of 3 lost with discounting)
Explicitly warns against price discounting or matching Datawise price concessions
Cites specific past deal IDs or company names from closed deal history (e.g. FinEdge Capital, Kuber Payments Hub, MediPulse Health, Bharat HealthTech, SecureNet Cyberworks)
